title: Grateful Dead Live at Grand Prix Racecourse on 1973-07-28
source: akg d1000e>sony tc-110, tdk c-120sd cassettes, no nr

ai_review.summary: Audience‑sourced recording with surprisingly crisp sound captures a high‑energy mid‑'73 Dead concert, but the second set is missing.
ai_review.review: The tape, recorded from the audience, delivers an impressively clear top end and vivid crowd ambience that lets listeners hear the band’s classic mid‑’73 swing. Reviewers praise the overall performance and recording quality, though one user notes the glaring omission of the entire second set, pulling the experience down.

ai_rating.rationale: One detailed 4‑star review lauds both performance and sound quality; another 1‑star review flags a missing second set, resulting in an average rating around the midpoint with mixed feedback.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp top end and clear crowd ambience; low/mid frequencies slightly under‑represented but overall very pleasant for an audience tape.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific comments on set structure; generally described as a solid mid‑'73 Dead show.

band_member_comments.Jerry: General praise of Garcia's guitar tone and overall playing.
